required.how: runtime mechanism recorded in model.extra_body or model.runtime

identity_rule: a candidate is a SERVED VARIANT = checkpoint + quantisation + runtime/server + inference settings; starting accuracy, throughput and eligibility belong to that exact variant on that host (operator amendment item 2)
material_difference: two receipts are the SAME served variant iff checkpoint, quant, runtime family (first token of model.runtime, lower-cased) and extra_body are equal; otherwise they are distinct measurements (never averaged)
